headline: Can CBRE Group Stock Keep Its Winning Streak Alive in Q3?
summary: CBRE is set to report Q3 results on Oct. 22 after four straight earnings beats. With revenues and EPS forecast to climb, can leasing and outsourcing sustain momentum?

headline: Soneil Investments Acquires 6-Property GTA Portfolio for $180M+
summary: Soneil Investments has completed the acquisition of a six-property commercial real estate portfolio across the Greater Toronto Area for more than $180 million. The portfolio comprises approximately 650,000 square feet of industrial, retail and mixed-commercial space across Markham, Toronto, Vaughan, and Mississauga and is home to over 100 tenants. CIBC provided acquisition financing, while CBRE's National Investment Team acted as broker.
